name: home-assistant-manager
title_zh: 安全改 Home Assistant 配置并秒级生效
tagline_zh: 改 YAML 怕改崩？它先跑 core check 再部署，git 或 scp 随你选；reload 还是 res。
tagline_en: Edit YAML without fear: core check before deploy, git or scp, reload vs restart done right, verify via logs and.
desc_en: Manage Home Assistant configuration safely and fast — edit and deploy YAML (automations, blueprints, scripts, scenes, templates, MQTT), validate with ha core check, deploy via git or rapid scp, reload-vs-restart correctly, verify changes from logs, traces and entity state, and build Lovelace dashboards. Use for any Home Assistant config, automation, template, or dashboard work over SSH/hass-cli/MC
why_zh: 机制上把「改配置」拆成校验、部署、生效、验证四步，每一步都有明确命令和回退判断，不是让你自己猜。
why_en: Turns config edits into a four-step pipeline — validate, deploy, reload, verify — with explicit commands and rollback logic, so.
limit_zh: 只认 SSH 或 hass-cli 可达的 Home Assistant；Lovelace 仪表盘只生成 YAML 不。
limit_en: Requires SSH/hass-cli access to HA; Lovelace output is YAML only, no preview; core check breaks on HA < 2023.6.
